schema.spec_version: Semantic version of the manifest format specification. Breaking changes increment major version.
schema.manifest_version: Auto-incrementing version of this manifest file. Patch increments on each regeneration.
schema.manifest_generated: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when this manifest was generated.

dataset.name: Internal dataset identifier used in file paths and programmatic access
dataset.label: Human-readable dataset name for display purposes

storage._description: Storage configuration for data access (S3 and HPC)
storage.s3_bucket: AWS S3 bucket name where data is stored
storage.s3_prefix: S3 key prefix path within the bucket
storage.s3_base_uri: Full S3 URI base path for data files (s3://{bucket}/{prefix})
storage.s3_manifest_base_uri: S3 URI directory where manifest versions are stored
storage.hpc_base_path: Absolute filesystem path for HPC local access (NREL Kestrel)

partition._description: Spatial partitioning configuration for parquet files
partition.decimal_places: Number of decimal places used in partition path encoding. For decimal_places=2: lat_dec = int(abs(lat * 100) % 100)
partition.coord_digits_max: Maximum decimal precision for latitude/longitude values in filenames
partition.index_max_digits: Zero-padding width for face_id in filenames (e.g., 8 means face=00001234)
partition.data_level: Data processing level identifier used in file paths (e.g., 'b1_vap_by_point_partition')
partition.grid_resolution_deg: Grid cell size in degrees, derived as 1.0 / (10 ** decimal_places)

path_template._description: Template string for reconstructing parquet file paths from point data
path_template.template: The path template string with {placeholder} variables

placeholders.data_version: Data version for the location (e.g., '1.0.0'). Path uses 'v' prefix (v1.0.0)
placeholders.lat: Full precision latitude string from point data
placeholders.lon: Full precision longitude string from point data
placeholders.temporal: Temporal resolution code ('1h' for hourly, '30m' for half-hourly)

locations.label: Human-readable location name for display
locations.latest_version: String indicating the latest/recommended data version for this location

versions._description: Object mapping data version strings to version metadata
versions.release_date: ISO 8601 date when this version was released

locations.point_count: Total number of data points (faces) for this location
locations.date: Dataset start date in YYYYMMDD format
locations.time: Dataset start time in HHMMSS format
locations.geospatial_lat_min: Minimum latitude of location bounding box (degrees_north)
locations.geospatial_lat_max: Maximum latitude of location bounding box (degrees_north)
locations.geospatial_lon_min: Minimum longitude of location bounding box (degrees_east)
locations.geospatial_lon_max: Maximum longitude of location bounding box (degrees_east)
locations.geospatial_bounds: WKT POLYGON string defining the location boundary

grid_centroids._description: Arrays of grid cell centroid coordinates for spatial indexing
grid_centroids.lat: Array of grid cell centroid latitudes (degrees_north)
grid_centroids.lon: Array of grid cell centroid longitudes (degrees_east), same length as lat

schema.grid_details_path: Relative path from manifest to grid detail files directory
schema.total_grids: Total number of grid cells across all locations
schema.total_points: Total number of data points (faces) across all locations
